generation.scope: For any finite orbit of genus-one quartic complete-intersection subcurves of a one-dimensional point graph, including nonreduced marks, regularity is equivalent to invertible quartic product relations between consecutive permuted marks. This covers every reduced quartic complete-intersection mark, even when distinct marks share components; all marks are then enumerable and unmarked isomorphism and periods reduce to the finite list of comparisons.

open_mathematics: Analyze uniform point-graph regularity via the finite-length section quotient and cubic interpolation; separately use the excess bound to classify the possible smooth sextic and quintic point curves.
